elements.business_rules_text:
=== Entity-level rules (shared) ===
General Requirements: ## GR1
The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity contains data elements that are attributes of non-instructional staff assignments, instructional educational aides (not prekindergarten aides), Special Education and related services, and additional responsibilities of teachers.  The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity can be reported with a StaffClassification 087 (teacher) to report the additional responsibilities of teachers (StaffService  SRXXXXXX) or when the services provided are special education and related services (StaffService  SEXXXXXX). All other instructional services provided by StaffClassification 087 (teacher) should be reported using the StaffSectionAssociation.
For guidance on reporting StaffClassification Teacher (087) and Prekindergarten Aide (033) for instructional assignments, please see the StaffSectionAssociation Entity.
The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity reflects the assignments for professional and para-professional staff (excluding prekindergarten aides). Multiple records are required for persons who perform duties on more than one campus, assume more than one role, or perform more than one type of service. A staff can be reported with the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity and StaffSectionAssociation Entity for instructional assignments.
Detailed schedules are not reported for Instructional Educational Aides (StaffClassification 033) and certified interpreters (StaffClassification 036). Instead, a StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity is submitted showing the total monthly minutes the staff person serves in that role. Generic aide and interpreter StaffService (C343) (formerly SERVICE-ID C022) are available for the record. Staff responsibilities for Prekindergarten educational aides are reported through the StaffSectionAssociation Entity using the ClassroomPosition descriptor PK Classroom Aide (05).
## GR2
PEIMS Fall Submission (1):
The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity is reported for the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) for non-instructional staff assignments, instructional educational aides (not prekindergarten aides), Special Education and related services, and additional responsibilities of teachers. (See StaffClassification vs. StaffService Matrix below for a list of StaffClassifications reported using the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.) This reporting requirement applies to all professionals and para-professionals employed on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October). The data elements that must be reported for each StaffClassification (C021) are specified in the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity data validation rules.
If a school is closed for one or more days during the four weeks in October that include the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), then the staff responsibilities, the services performed, and the minutes associated with those services should be reported as if the school was in operation for each of the days.
Each LEA must report a staff person identified as StaffClassification 027 (Superintendent/Chief Administrative Officer/Chief Executive Officer/President). If an Assistant Superintendent or other administrative professional serves as the superintendent due to a vacant superintendent position, that person should be reported as the superintendent. This reporting requirement may result in that person having two different StaffClassifications in the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity. If the superintendent is on leave (still employed by the LEA) on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) and another person serves as the superintendent, more than one StaffClassification 027 may be reported.
All persons in professional roles in an LEA must be reported in Submission 1 with the appropriate StaffClassification. (See StaffClassification vs. StaffService Matrix below for a list of StaffClassifications reporting using the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.)

Special Requirements: ## SR1
Shared Service Arrangement
The shared service arrangement fiscal agent should report the responsibility data for those administrative or itinerant employees who the fiscal agent pays.
When the fiscal agent is a LEA and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported will be that of the member district campus. When the fiscal agent is an ESC and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported must end in 751, 998, or 999.
Each member district will report the  StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity data for any professional employees (non-instructional, instructional educational aides (not prekindergarten aides), Special Education and related services, and additional responsibilities of teachers) it pays who perform shared services arrangement-related services. For guidance on reporting shared service arrangements for Teacher (087) and Prekindergarten Aide (033), please see the StaffSectionAssociation Entity. If a staff member were an employee of the shared services arrangement fiscal agent and a shared services arrangement member, each organization would report all the staff data about that individual’s employment with it. TEA would receive only duplicate identification and demographic data in such a case.

## SR2
High School Equivalency Program (HSEP)
The HSEP is authorized under §29.087 of the Texas Education Code (TEC) and Chapter 89, Subchapter DD of the Texas Administrative Code. This program has no relationship to TEC Chapter 37, Subchapter A, Alternative Settings for Behavior Management. Only those school districts that have applied and been approved by the agency may operate High School Equivalency Programs (HSEP). The HSEP leads to a Certificate of High School Equivalency. Eligible participants must be 16 or older at the beginning of the semester or school year. The grade level is wherever the students are in their educational progress. The PopulationServed is usually 01 (Regular) unless the district uses compensatory funds for this program. The StaffService for HSEP is SR000008.
## SR3
Texas School for the Deaf (TSD), Texas School for the Blind and Visually Impaired (TSBVI), and the Lone Star School District (LSSD) (formerly Texas Juvenile Justice Department TJJD)) schools do not report the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.

Data Element Reporting Requirements: ## DR1
Staff Reference
The Staff Reference represents the identifier assigned to a staff member.
School Reference
The School Reference represents the identifier assigned to a school.
StaffClassification (E0721) identifies the capacity in which a person serves. Examples counselors, art therapists, and the superintendent.
If a non-instructional professional person’s actual role is not found among the list of values for StaffClassification (C021), choose the closest approximation to the actual role available in the table. Some non-instructional professional and para-professional staff may also be reported with an AuxiliaryRoleId in the StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation Entity if the person provides both professional or para-professional and non-professional auxiliary services. An example includes an educational aide who also drives a school bus route. Some StaffClassification (C021) are either similar or identical to the AuxiliaryRole (C213). Select only the roles applicable to the StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity for these similar or identical roles.
StaffClassification 033 - Instructional Educational Aides
Instructional Educational Aides are reported as StaffClassification 033. StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity records are not reported for Non-Instructional Aides such as library clerks, office clerks, attendance clerks, health clerks, etc. In some instances, an instructional educational aide may serve in a library. A StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity record is reported for aides who work in a library and spend most of their time helping students. Library clerks, who shelve books, check books in and out and handle paperwork for the librarian are not reported on a StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity record and are, therefore, considered auxiliary staff. Staff Responsibilities for Prekindergarten educational aides are reported through the StaffSectionAssociation Entity using the ClassroomPosition descriptor PK Classroom Aide (05).
For further StaffClassification guidance, see the charts below.
BeginDate (E3010) is the first day a staff is assigned to the StaffClassification descriptor.
EndDate (E3020) is the first day after the last day a staff was assigned to the StaffClassification descriptor.
SharedServiceArrangementStaff (E1015) indicates whether the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation or StaffSectionAssociation being reported is part of a shared services arrangement for which the education service center is the fiscal agent.
SharedServiceArrangementStaff is completed by education service centers only. This data element is not valid for school districts.
## DR2
StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation>StaffServiceSet
The StaffServiceSet common type includes a set of data elements that provide information about the services supplied by a staff member including the StaffServiceBeginDate and StaffServiceEndDate.
StaffService (E3072) refers to the services supplied by staff.
SPEDStudentAgeRange (E3059) identifies the age range of students receiving special education services that teaching and paraprofessional staff provided services to.
For StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation, a SPEDStudentAgeRange with a value other than 00 (Not Providing Special Education Services to Students) will only be reported for para-professional staff that provide services to students receiving special education services.  SPEDStudentAgeRange will only be reported for Educational Aides (StaffClassification 033) serving Students Receiving Special Education Services (PopulationServed 06).
For special education educational aides who serve more than one age range level, report at least one StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity per age range below:

PopulationServed (E0747) identifies the student population for which a service has been designed or is intended. It does not necessarily identify the program eligibility of the students who receive the service.
The correct descriptor is determined by the population for which the service was designed, not by the student population that receives a service. If two or more populations are being served, only one record should be reported using the population for which the service was designed. If intent cannot be determined, use descriptor 01 (Regular Students).
MonthlyMinutes (E1057) is the total minutes devoted to a particular service in a standard month. A standard month is the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
MonthlyMinutes represents a standard month of a service provided during the school year and is used to calculate FTEs. Even if there is a holiday or other non-school day during the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), report this value as if school was in operation.
MonthlyMinutes is reported for only one non-instructional StaffClassification 008 (Counselor) and is based upon 9600 minutes a month (8 hours per day x 5 days per week x 4 weeks per month).
NumberOfStudentsInClass (E0170) indicates the number of students in membership in the class or the number of students served by the staff member.
The number of students served by the staff member reported is based on the particular StaffService provided.
Instructional Educational Aides (StaffClassification 033) and Certified Interpreters (StaffClassification 036) should be reported with 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass.

=== Entity-level rules (shared) ===
General Requirements: ## GR1
The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity contains data elements that are attributes of non-instructional staff assignments, instructional educational aides (not prekindergarten aides), Special Education and related services, and additional responsibilities of teachers.  The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity can be reported with a StaffClassification 087 (teacher) to report the additional responsibilities of teachers (StaffService  SRXXXXXX) or when the services provided are special education and related services (StaffService  SEXXXXXX). All other instructional services provided by StaffClassification 087 (teacher) should be reported using the StaffSectionAssociation.
For guidance on reporting StaffClassification Teacher (087) and Prekindergarten Aide (033) for instructional assignments, please see the StaffSectionAssociation Entity.
The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity reflects the assignments for professional and para-professional staff (excluding prekindergarten aides). Multiple records are required for persons who perform duties on more than one campus, assume more than one role, or perform more than one type of service. A staff can be reported with the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity and StaffSectionAssociation Entity for instructional assignments.
Detailed schedules are not reported for Instructional Educational Aides (StaffClassification 033) and certified interpreters (StaffClassification 036). Instead, a StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity is submitted showing the total monthly minutes the staff person serves in that role. Generic aide and interpreter StaffService (C343) (formerly SERVICE-ID C022) are available for the record. Staff responsibilities for Prekindergarten educational aides are reported through the StaffSectionAssociation Entity using the ClassroomPosition descriptor PK Classroom Aide (05).
## GR2
PEIMS Fall Submission (1):
The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity is reported for the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) for non-instructional staff assignments, instructional educational aides (not prekindergarten aides), Special Education and related services, and additional responsibilities of teachers. (See StaffClassification vs. StaffService Matrix below for a list of StaffClassifications reported using the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.) This reporting requirement applies to all professionals and para-professionals employed on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October). The data elements that must be reported for each StaffClassification (C021) are specified in the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity data validation rules.
If a school is closed for one or more days during the four weeks in October that include the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), then the staff responsibilities, the services performed, and the minutes associated with those services should be reported as if the school was in operation for each of the days.
Each LEA must report a staff person identified as StaffClassification 027 (Superintendent/Chief Administrative Officer/Chief Executive Officer/President). If an Assistant Superintendent or other administrative professional serves as the superintendent due to a vacant superintendent position, that person should be reported as the superintendent. This reporting requirement may result in that person having two different StaffClassifications in the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity. If the superintendent is on leave (still employed by the LEA) on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) and another person serves as the superintendent, more than one StaffClassification 027 may be reported.
All persons in professional roles in an LEA must be reported in Submission 1 with the appropriate StaffClassification. (See StaffClassification vs. StaffService Matrix below for a list of StaffClassifications reporting using the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.)

Special Requirements: ## SR1
Shared Service Arrangement
The shared service arrangement fiscal agent should report the responsibility data for those administrative or itinerant employees who the fiscal agent pays.
When the fiscal agent is a LEA and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported will be that of the member district campus. When the fiscal agent is an ESC and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported must end in 751, 998, or 999.
Each member district will report the  StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity data for any professional employees (non-instructional, instructional educational aides (not prekindergarten aides), Special Education and related services, and additional responsibilities of teachers) it pays who perform shared services arrangement-related services. For guidance on reporting shared service arrangements for Teacher (087) and Prekindergarten Aide (033), please see the StaffSectionAssociation Entity. If a staff member were an employee of the shared services arrangement fiscal agent and a shared services arrangement member, each organization would report all the staff data about that individual’s employment with it. TEA would receive only duplicate identification and demographic data in such a case.

## SR2
High School Equivalency Program (HSEP)
The HSEP is authorized under §29.087 of the Texas Education Code (TEC) and Chapter 89, Subchapter DD of the Texas Administrative Code. This program has no relationship to TEC Chapter 37, Subchapter A, Alternative Settings for Behavior Management. Only those school districts that have applied and been approved by the agency may operate High School Equivalency Programs (HSEP). The HSEP leads to a Certificate of High School Equivalency. Eligible participants must be 16 or older at the beginning of the semester or school year. The grade level is wherever the students are in their educational progress. The PopulationServed is usually 01 (Regular) unless the district uses compensatory funds for this program. The StaffService for HSEP is SR000008.
## SR3
Texas School for the Deaf (TSD), Texas School for the Blind and Visually Impaired (TSBVI), and the Lone Star School District (LSSD) (formerly Texas Juvenile Justice Department TJJD)) schools do not report the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.

Data Element Reporting Requirements: ## DR1
Staff Reference
The Staff Reference represents the identifier assigned to a staff member.
School Reference
The School Reference represents the identifier assigned to a school.
StaffClassification (E0721) identifies the capacity in which a person serves. Examples counselors, art therapists, and the superintendent.
If a non-instructional professional person’s actual role is not found among the list of values for StaffClassification (C021), choose the closest approximation to the actual role available in the table. Some non-instructional professional and para-professional staff may also be reported with an AuxiliaryRoleId in the StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation Entity if the person provides both professional or para-professional and non-professional auxiliary services. An example includes an educational aide who also drives a school bus route. Some StaffClassification (C021) are either similar or identical to the AuxiliaryRole (C213). Select only the roles applicable to the StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity for these similar or identical roles.
StaffClassification 033 - Instructional Educational Aides
Instructional Educational Aides are reported as StaffClassification 033. StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity records are not reported for Non-Instructional Aides such as library clerks, office clerks, attendance clerks, health clerks, etc. In some instances, an instructional educational aide may serve in a library. A StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity record is reported for aides who work in a library and spend most of their time helping students. Library clerks, who shelve books, check books in and out and handle paperwork for the librarian are not reported on a StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity record and are, therefore, considered auxiliary staff. Staff Responsibilities for Prekindergarten educational aides are reported through the StaffSectionAssociation Entity using the ClassroomPosition descriptor PK Classroom Aide (05).
For further StaffClassification guidance, see the charts below.
BeginDate (E3010) is the first day a staff is assigned to the StaffClassification descriptor.
EndDate (E3020) is the first day after the last day a staff was assigned to the StaffClassification descriptor.
SharedServiceArrangementStaff (E1015) indicates whether the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation or StaffSectionAssociation being reported is part of a shared services arrangement for which the education service center is the fiscal agent.
SharedServiceArrangementStaff is completed by education service centers only. This data element is not valid for school districts.
## DR2
StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation>StaffServiceSet
The StaffServiceSet common type includes a set of data elements that provide information about the services supplied by a staff member including the StaffServiceBeginDate and StaffServiceEndDate.
StaffService (E3072) refers to the services supplied by staff.
SPEDStudentAgeRange (E3059) identifies the age range of students receiving special education services that teaching and paraprofessional staff provided services to.
For StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation, a SPEDStudentAgeRange with a value other than 00 (Not Providing Special Education Services to Students) will only be reported for para-professional staff that provide services to students receiving special education services.  SPEDStudentAgeRange will only be reported for Educational Aides (StaffClassification 033) serving Students Receiving Special Education Services (PopulationServed 06).
For special education educational aides who serve more than one age range level, report at least one StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity per age range below:

The correct descriptor is determined by the population for which the service was designed, not by the student population that receives a service. If intent cannot be determined, use descriptor 01 (Regular Students).

MonthlyMinutes represents a standard month of a service provided during the school year and is used to calculate FTEs. Even if there is a holiday or other non-school day during the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), report this value as if school was in operation.
MonthlyMinutes is reported for only one non-instructional StaffClassification 008 (Counselor) and is based upon 9600 minutes a month (8 hours per day x 5 days per week x 4 weeks per month).
NumberOfStudentsInClass (E0170) indicates the number of students in membership in the class or the number of students served by the staff member.
The number of students served by the staff member reported is based on the particular StaffService provided.

=== Entity-level rules (shared) ===
General Requirements: ## GR1
The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity contains data elements that are attributes of non-instructional staff assignments, instructional educational aides (not prekindergarten aides), Special Education and related services, and additional responsibilities of teachers.  The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity can be reported with a StaffClassification 087 (teacher) to report the additional responsibilities of teachers (StaffService  SRXXXXXX) or when the services provided are special education and related services (StaffService  SEXXXXXX). All other instructional services provided by StaffClassification 087 (teacher) should be reported using the StaffSectionAssociation.
For guidance on reporting StaffClassification Teacher (087) and Prekindergarten Aide (033) for instructional assignments, please see the StaffSectionAssociation Entity.
The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity reflects the assignments for professional and para-professional staff (excluding prekindergarten aides). Multiple records are required for persons who perform duties on more than one campus, assume more than one role, or perform more than one type of service. A staff can be reported with the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity and StaffSectionAssociation Entity for instructional assignments.
Detailed schedules are not reported for Instructional Educational Aides (StaffClassification 033) and certified interpreters (StaffClassification 036). Instead, a StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity is submitted showing the total monthly minutes the staff person serves in that role. Generic aide and interpreter StaffService (C343) (formerly SERVICE-ID C022) are available for the record. Staff responsibilities for Prekindergarten educational aides are reported through the StaffSectionAssociation Entity using the ClassroomPosition descriptor PK Classroom Aide (05).
## GR2
PEIMS Fall Submission (1):
The StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity is reported for the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) for non-instructional staff assignments, instructional educational aides (not prekindergarten aides), Special Education and related services, and additional responsibilities of teachers. (See StaffClassification vs. StaffService Matrix below for a list of StaffClassifications reported using the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.) This reporting requirement applies to all professionals and para-professionals employed on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October). The data elements that must be reported for each StaffClassification (C021) are specified in the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity data validation rules.
If a school is closed for one or more days during the four weeks in October that include the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), then the staff responsibilities, the services performed, and the minutes associated with those services should be reported as if the school was in operation for each of the days.
Each LEA must report a staff person identified as StaffClassification 027 (Superintendent/Chief Administrative Officer/Chief Executive Officer/President). If an Assistant Superintendent or other administrative professional serves as the superintendent due to a vacant superintendent position, that person should be reported as the superintendent. This reporting requirement may result in that person having two different StaffClassifications in the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity. If the superintendent is on leave (still employed by the LEA) on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) and another person serves as the superintendent, more than one StaffClassification 027 may be reported.
All persons in professional roles in an LEA must be reported in Submission 1 with the appropriate StaffClassification. (See StaffClassification vs. StaffService Matrix below for a list of StaffClassifications reporting using the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.)

Special Requirements: ## SR1
Shared Service Arrangement
The shared service arrangement fiscal agent should report the responsibility data for those administrative or itinerant employees who the fiscal agent pays.
When the fiscal agent is a LEA and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported will be that of the member district campus. When the fiscal agent is an ESC and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported must end in 751, 998, or 999.
Each member district will report the  StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity data for any professional employees (non-instructional, instructional educational aides (not prekindergarten aides), Special Education and related services, and additional responsibilities of teachers) it pays who perform shared services arrangement-related services. For guidance on reporting shared service arrangements for Teacher (087) and Prekindergarten Aide (033), please see the StaffSectionAssociation Entity. If a staff member were an employee of the shared services arrangement fiscal agent and a shared services arrangement member, each organization would report all the staff data about that individual’s employment with it. TEA would receive only duplicate identification and demographic data in such a case.

## SR2
High School Equivalency Program (HSEP)
The HSEP is authorized under §29.087 of the Texas Education Code (TEC) and Chapter 89, Subchapter DD of the Texas Administrative Code. This program has no relationship to TEC Chapter 37, Subchapter A, Alternative Settings for Behavior Management. Only those school districts that have applied and been approved by the agency may operate High School Equivalency Programs (HSEP). The HSEP leads to a Certificate of High School Equivalency. Eligible participants must be 16 or older at the beginning of the semester or school year. The grade level is wherever the students are in their educational progress. The PopulationServed is usually 01 (Regular) unless the district uses compensatory funds for this program. The StaffService for HSEP is SR000008.
## SR3
Texas School for the Deaf (TSD), Texas School for the Blind and Visually Impaired (TSBVI), and the Lone Star School District (LSSD) (formerly Texas Juvenile Justice Department TJJD)) schools do not report the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.

Data Element Reporting Requirements: ## DR1
Staff Reference
The Staff Reference represents the identifier assigned to a staff member.
School Reference
The School Reference represents the identifier assigned to a school.
StaffClassification (E0721) identifies the capacity in which a person serves. Examples counselors, art therapists, and the superintendent.
If a non-instructional professional person’s actual role is not found among the list of values for StaffClassification (C021), choose the closest approximation to the actual role available in the table. Some non-instructional professional and para-professional staff may also be reported with an AuxiliaryRoleId in the StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation Entity if the person provides both professional or para-professional and non-professional auxiliary services. An example includes an educational aide who also drives a school bus route. Some StaffClassification (C021) are either similar or identical to the AuxiliaryRole (C213). Select only the roles applicable to the StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity for these similar or identical roles.
StaffClassification 033 - Instructional Educational Aides
Instructional Educational Aides are reported as StaffClassification 033. StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity records are not reported for Non-Instructional Aides such as library clerks, office clerks, attendance clerks, health clerks, etc. In some instances, an instructional educational aide may serve in a library. A StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity record is reported for aides who work in a library and spend most of their time helping students. Library clerks, who shelve books, check books in and out and handle paperwork for the librarian are not reported on a StaffEducationOrganizationAssigmentAssociation Entity record and are, therefore, considered auxiliary staff. Staff Responsibilities for Prekindergarten educational aides are reported through the StaffSectionAssociation Entity using the ClassroomPosition descriptor PK Classroom Aide (05).
For further StaffClassification guidance, see the charts below.
BeginDate (E3010) is the first day a staff is assigned to the StaffClassification descriptor.
EndDate (E3020) is the first day after the last day a staff was assigned to the StaffClassification descriptor.

SharedServiceArrangementStaff is completed by education service centers only. This data element is not valid for school districts.
## DR2

For StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation, a SPEDStudentAgeRange with a value other than 00 (Not Providing Special Education Services to Students) will only be reported for para-professional staff that provide services to students receiving special education services.  SPEDStudentAgeRange will only be reported for Educational Aides (StaffClassification 033) serving Students Receiving Special Education Services (PopulationServed 06).
For special education educational aides who serve more than one age range level, report at least one StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity per age range below:

The correct descriptor is determined by the population for which the service was designed, not by the student population that receives a service. If two or more populations are being served, only one record should be reported using the population for which the service was designed. If intent cannot be determined, use descriptor 01 (Regular Students).
MonthlyMinutes (E1057) is the total minutes devoted to a particular service in a standard month. A standard month is the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
MonthlyMinutes represents a standard month of a service provided during the school year and is used to calculate FTEs. Even if there is a holiday or other non-school day during the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), report this value as if school was in operation.
MonthlyMinutes is reported for only one non-instructional StaffClassification 008 (Counselor) and is based upon 9600 minutes a month (8 hours per day x 5 days per week x 4 weeks per month).
NumberOfStudentsInClass (E0170) indicates the number of students in membership in the class or the number of students served by the staff member.
The number of students served by the staff member reported is based on the particular StaffService provided.
Instructional Educational Aides (StaffClassification 033) and Certified Interpreters (StaffClassification 036) should be reported with 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass.

elements.business_rules_text:
=== Entity-level rules (shared) ===
General Requirements: ## GR1
The StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation Entity contains data elements that are attributes of staff employment.
The StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation Entity is submitted for all staff in PEIMS Fall Submission (1).
PEIMS Fall Submission (1):
All staff reported on the Staff entity, regardless of StaffClassification, must also be reported with payroll summary data in the StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation Entity.

Special Requirements: ## SR1
If an LEA has contracted out all or part of a campus operation to a third-party vendor, the LEA is still required to report a StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation entity for StaffClassification 087 and 047. Even though the teachers are contracted through a third-party vendor, the teachers are teaching at a campus in the LEA. They must be reported to include the information in the staff full-time equivalent (FTE) calculations for the Academic Excellence Indicator System and the Student Assessment Data Portal as required by law. It would not be appropriate to omit a contracted teacher teaching at an LEA campus from the staff data reporting.
All staff employed by the ESC or LEA must be reported with a StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation Entity, including those substitute teachers who are replacing teachers who have quit, died, or been fired and have not been permanently replaced. LEAs are generally not required to report substitute teachers or employees (hourly or non-hourly) who work only on an “as needed” basis. These persons do not have a regular work schedule with a predictable NumberDaysEmployed or PercentDayEmployed and should not be reported.
NumberDaysEmployed and PercentDayEmployed are reported as it was planned for the school year as of the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October). If a staff person’s situation changes after the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), report that person only as they were employed on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October). For example, if a staff member changed from full-time to part-time after the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), the staff member would be reported as full-time. If a person does not work the same number of days as shown in the contract, then the actual number of days the employee will work must be reported. This situation may occur when a person does not begin work at the start of the school year.

Data Element Reporting Requirements: ## DR1
Staff Reference
The Staff Reference represents the identifier assigned to a staff member.
LocalEducationAgency Reference
The LocalEducationAgency Reference represents the identifier assigned to the Local Education Agency.
EmploymentStatus is required in the Ed-Fi model and is mandatory for the entity to be loaded into the individual operational data store (IODS). EmploymentStatus will not be promoted to TSDS.
## DR2
StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation>DaysEmployedSet
The DaysEmployedSet common type captures the percent and number of days employed by the employee and the BeginDate and EndDate associated to the PercentDaysEmployed and NumberDaysEmployed data elements.
PercentDayEmployed (E0760) is the percentage of a standard LEA workday for which the employee is hired to work.
For an employee on contract, the percentage may be determined directly from the contract: full-time = “100”; half-time = “50”; and so on. For an employee not on contract, the percentage may be determined as follows:
Determine the standard workday hours for your LEA. Examples might be 7 or 8 hours. Divide the employee's number of work hours by the LEA standard workday hours to determine PercentDayEmployed.
Example: the standard workday for the LEA is 7 hours. An employee is hired to work for 4 hours a day. This data element is “57” for this employee because 4/7 = .571, which is rounded down.
The value reported must be a whole number. If the computed value is greater than ". ##50...", use rounding to the next higher percent to avoid using decimals or fractions. For example, .6251 is reported as "63".
Employees such as cafeteria workers and bus drivers who work only a few hours daily are not to be reported as “100” in this field. Do not look at the job but rather the hours worked related to the standard LEA workday.
NumberDaysEmployed (E0160) indicates the actual number of at-work days within the school year that a person is scheduled to work in the LEA. This number does not include holidays, weekends, and any other days the employee is not scheduled to work.
If a person does not work the same number of days as shown in the contract, then the actual number of days the employee will work must be reported. This situation may occur when a person does not begin work at the start of the school year.
Staff Payroll Calculated Values
Full-Time Equivalents (FTEs) are calculated in the following manner:
If NumberDaysEmployed is greater than or equal to 187, then FTE = PercentDayEmployed divided by 100.
If NumberDaysEmployed is less than 187, then FTE =
(PercentDayEmployed divided by 100) X (NumberDaysEmployed)
187
Base Salary is the total of all PayrollAmount where PayrollActivity is 80 (Base Salary).
FTE Salary is Base Salary divided by FTE.
BeginDate (E3010) is the first day staff is assigned the PercentDayEmployed and NumberDaysEmployed.
EndDate (E3020) is the first day after the last day staff was assigned the PercentDayEmployed and NumberDaysEmployed.
## DR3
StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation>AuxiliaryRoleIdSet
The AuxiliaryRoleIdSet common type captures the role ID for the auxiliary employee and the BeginDate and EndDate associated to the AuxiliaryRoleId data element.
AuxiliaryRoleId (E1594) identifies the capacity in which a nonexempt auxiliary employee serves.
The AuxiliaryRoleId is reported for all LEA employees who serve the LEA in a non-professional or non-para-professional role. Persons with an AuxiliaryRoleId are reported with base pay associated with Object 6129 (Salaries Or Wages For Support Personnel). Some professional staff may also be reported with an AuxiliaryRoleId. An example would be a StaffClassification 087 (Teacher) that also drives a bus route for the school. This person would have at least two payroll accounting entries: Object 6119 (Salaries Or Wages-Teachers And Other Professional Personnel) and Object 6129 (Salaries Or Wages For Support Personnel).
There is some duplication between the StaffClassification table and the AuxiliaryRoleId table; therefore, it is the LEA’s discretion to determine if the staff person is employed in a professional or non-professional capacity.
For additional guidance on reporting StaffClassification or the AuxiliaryRoleId for staff, please see the “When to Report StaffClassification or AuxiliaryRoleId” table in the Staff entity.
BeginDate (E3010) is the first day a nonexempt auxiliary staff is assigned to the AuxiliaryRoleId descriptor.
EndDate (E3020) is the first day after the last day a nonexempt auxiliary staff was assigned to the AuxiliaryRoleId descriptor.
## DR4
StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation>EmploymentPeriod
The EmploymentPeriod common type captures the employment period for the particular staff member.
HireDate (E3032) is the first day a staff member is employed at an educational organization.
EndDate (E3020) is the first day after the last day a staff member was employed at an educational organization.
Note: The HireDate should be the original date the employee began working in any position in the local education agency (LEA). If the employee has a break in employment at the LEA an EndDate should have been added to the original HireDate and a new HireDate should be added to reflect the second employment term.
If the employee began in the LEA working in a position not reported in the PEIMS Fall Submission, the EmploymentPeriod common type should have an EndDate added and a new EmploymentPeriod common type would be reported. This may occur when a staff moves from being employed in a non-PEIMS reportable position into a PEIMS reportable position. A PEIMS reportable position is any position where the staff is reported in the PEIMS Fall Submission (1) such as the following:
- Staff serving an LEA as of the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) are reported.
- Staff employed as of the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October). This includes staff on various types of unpaid leave who are still officially employed.
- Volunteers who are providing a professional service as of the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
- Contracted professionals who are serving the LEA on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
- Teachers employed at the in-district charter campus by an organization that has been granted a campus charter under TEC, Chapter 12, Subchapter C and is eligible for benefits under TEC, §11.174 and 11.147(b).
Staff employed in a non-PEIMS reportable position may include the following:
- Short-term substitute teachers, although they may be included on the local payroll.
- Volunteers who are not providing a professional service.

## DR2
StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation>DaysEmployedSet
The DaysEmployedSet common type captures the percent and number of days employed by the employee and the BeginDate and EndDate associated to the PercentDaysEmployed and NumberDaysEmployed data elements.
PercentDayEmployed (E0760) is the percentage of a standard LEA workday for which the employee is hired to work.
For an employee on contract, the percentage may be determined directly from the contract: full-time = “100”; half-time = “50”; and so on. For an employee not on contract, the percentage may be determined as follows:
Determine the standard workday hours for your LEA. Examples might be 7 or 8 hours. Divide the employee's number of work hours by the LEA standard workday hours to determine PercentDayEmployed.
Example: the standard workday for the LEA is 7 hours. An employee is hired to work for 4 hours a day. This data element is “57” for this employee because 4/7 = .571, which is rounded down.
The value reported must be a whole number. If the computed value is greater than ". ##50...", use rounding to the next higher percent to avoid using decimals or fractions. For example, .6251 is reported as "63".
Employees such as cafeteria workers and bus drivers who work only a few hours daily are not to be reported as “100” in this field. Do not look at the job but rather the hours worked related to the standard LEA workday.
NumberDaysEmployed (E0160) indicates the actual number of at-work days within the school year that a person is scheduled to work in the LEA. This number does not include holidays, weekends, and any other days the employee is not scheduled to work.
If a person does not work the same number of days as shown in the contract, then the actual number of days the employee will work must be reported. This situation may occur when a person does not begin work at the start of the school year.
Staff Payroll Calculated Values
Full-Time Equivalents (FTEs) are calculated in the following manner:
If NumberDaysEmployed is greater than or equal to 187, then FTE = PercentDayEmployed divided by 100.
If NumberDaysEmployed is less than 187, then FTE =
(PercentDayEmployed divided by 100) X (NumberDaysEmployed)
187
Base Salary is the total of all PayrollAmount where PayrollActivity is 80 (Base Salary).
FTE Salary is Base Salary divided by FTE.
BeginDate (E3010) is the first day staff is assigned the PercentDayEmployed and NumberDaysEmployed.
EndDate (E3020) is the first day after the last day staff was assigned the PercentDayEmployed and NumberDaysEmployed.
## DR3
StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation>AuxiliaryRoleIdSet
The AuxiliaryRoleIdSet common type captures the role ID for the auxiliary employee and the BeginDate and EndDate associated to the AuxiliaryRoleId data element.
AuxiliaryRoleId (E1594) identifies the capacity in which a nonexempt auxiliary employee serves.
The AuxiliaryRoleId is reported for all LEA employees who serve the LEA in a non-professional or non-para-professional role. Persons with an AuxiliaryRoleId are reported with base pay associated with Object 6129 (Salaries Or Wages For Support Personnel). Some professional staff may also be reported with an AuxiliaryRoleId. An example would be a StaffClassification 087 (Teacher) that also drives a bus route for the school. This person would have at least two payroll accounting entries: Object 6119 (Salaries Or Wages-Teachers And Other Professional Personnel) and Object 6129 (Salaries Or Wages For Support Personnel).
There is some duplication between the StaffClassification table and the AuxiliaryRoleId table; therefore, it is the LEA’s discretion to determine if the staff person is employed in a professional or non-professional capacity.
For additional guidance on reporting StaffClassification or the AuxiliaryRoleId for staff, please see the “When to Report StaffClassification or AuxiliaryRoleId” table in the Staff entity.
BeginDate (E3010) is the first day a nonexempt auxiliary staff is assigned to the AuxiliaryRoleId descriptor.
EndDate (E3020) is the first day after the last day a nonexempt auxiliary staff was assigned to the AuxiliaryRoleId descriptor.
## DR4
StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation>EmploymentPeriod
The EmploymentPeriod common type captures the employment period for the particular staff member.
HireDate (E3032) is the first day a staff member is employed at an educational organization.
EndDate (E3020) is the first day after the last day a staff member was employed at an educational organization.
Note: The HireDate should be the original date the employee began working in any position in the local education agency (LEA). If the employee has a break in employment at the LEA an EndDate should have been added to the original HireDate and a new HireDate should be added to reflect the second employment term.
If the employee began in the LEA working in a position not reported in the PEIMS Fall Submission, the EmploymentPeriod common type should have an EndDate added and a new EmploymentPeriod common type would be reported. This may occur when a staff moves from being employed in a non-PEIMS reportable position into a PEIMS reportable position. A PEIMS reportable position is any position where the staff is reported in the PEIMS Fall Submission (1) such as the following:
- Staff serving an LEA as of the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) are reported.
- Staff employed as of the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October). This includes staff on various types of unpaid leave who are still officially employed.
- Volunteers who are providing a professional service as of the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
- Contracted professionals who are serving the LEA on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
- Teachers employed at the in-district charter campus by an organization that has been granted a campus charter under TEC, Chapter 12, Subchapter C and is eligible for benefits under TEC, §11.174 and 11.147(b).
Staff employed in a non-PEIMS reportable position may include the following:
- Short-term substitute teachers, although they may be included on the local payroll.
- Volunteers who are not providing a professional service.

All staff reported on the Staff entity, regardless of StaffClassification, must also be reported with payroll summary data in the StaffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociation Entity.

These persons do not have a regular work schedule with a predictable NumberDaysEmployed or PercentDayEmployed and should not be reported.

=== Entity-level rules (shared) ===
General Requirements: ## GR1
A local education agency (LEA) MUST report all professional services provided by teachers (StaffClassification 087) at an LEA through the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation entity, the StaffSectionAssociation entity or both for TEA to compute the teacher full-time equivalent (FTE) calculations for the LEA. If data for a staff member is reported through both entities, TEA will combine the data to accurately reflect the Staff FTE.
The CourseOffering, Section, and StaffSectionAssociation Entities are primarily used to report the responsibilities of a StaffClassification 087 (teacher) when the services provided by the teacher match one or more CourseCode. This includes but is not limited to teacher of record, assistant teacher, support teacher, or substitute teacher assigned to classes in the LEA master schedule, and teachers in an atypical role such as SPED, Dyslexia, GT, Intervention, pull-out teachers, etc., not assigned to a specific class but providing services with a corresponding CourseCode. The LEA must determine the appropriate CourseCode based on the services provided by the teacher to the students.
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity reflects the teachers, some substitutes, and prekindergarten instructional aides. Multiple records are required for persons who perform duties on more than one campus or assume more than one role. By definition, if no StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported, the assumption is made that the person is an auxiliary staff member or assignments are reported through the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.
## GR2
PEIMS Fall Submission (1):
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for the four weeks in October that include the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) for staff employed on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
If a school is closed for one or more days during the four weeks in October that include the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), then the staff responsibilities, the services performed, and the minutes associated with those services, should be reported as if the school was in operation for each of the days.
It is necessary for each LEA to report all professional services provided by persons at an LEA through the StaffSectionAssociation or the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entities in order for TEA to compute and report the staff FTE data for the LEA.
Staff responsibilities that occur before or after the normal school day for events where students do not receive credit are not reported (this includes but is not limited to sports practice, band practice, UIL clubs and practices). Staff responsibilities for courses taken for credit (including but not limited to zero hour courses) and Adult Basic Ed classes are considered part of the normal school day for StaffSectionAssociation Entity reporting purposes. Therefore, courses that are offered to students before or after school for course credit must be reported with a StaffSectionAssociation Entity.
If an instructional professional performs more than one service in the same classroom setting, then each of those services are reported on an individual StaffSectionAssociation Entity. For example, there are not enough French foreign language students (French I, French II, and French III) to make up separate classes. If these classes are combined in the same classroom at the same time, then a StaffSectionAssociation Entity will be reported for each Course (French I, French II, and French III).
Physical education, fine arts, and special education classes on elementary campuses may be reported using only one record or may be reported section by section, if desired. Because of legislative requirements for class size reporting, districts should report staff responsibility data at the lowest level possible.
Detailed schedules are not reported for ClassroomPosition 05 (PK Classroom Aide). Instead, a StaffSectionAssociation Entity is submitted showing the total monthly minutes the staff person serves in that role. The NumberOfStudentsInClass should be reported as 0 for these roles.  The actual NumberOfStudentsInClass should be reported with ClassroomPosition 01 (Teacher of Record).
PEIMS Extended Year Submission (4):
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for teachers providing instruction for the Additional Days School Year (ADSY) program. The NumberOfStudentsInClass should reflect the number of students participating in the ADSY program.
## GR3
StaffSectionAssociation Entities for local credit courses (8XXXXXXX) are not promoted in any of the TSDS Core Collections.
Class Roster Winter Submission:
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for all LEA-employed or contracted teachers of courses offered in grades EE-12 as of the last Friday in February. CourseCodes that begin with "SA," "SE," "SR," "SS," or "8" are not promoted.
Early Childhood Data System Collections
Prekindergarten (PK) Submission:
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for each ClassroomPosition that provides instruction for students in grade level PK. If more than one of any ClassroomPosition is assigned to a PK section, all StaffSectionAssociation Entities should be reported with the actual BeginDate and EndDate.
Kindergarten (KG) Submission:
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for each ClassroomPosition that provides instruction for students in grade level KG. If more than one of any ClassroomPosition is assigned to a KG section, all StaffSectionAssociation Entities should be reported with the actual BeginDate and EndDate.

Special Requirements: ## SR1
Shared Service Arrangement
The shared service arrangement fiscal agent should report the responsibility data using the StaffSectionAssociation Entity for those instructional employees who the fiscal agent pays.
When the fiscal agent is a LEA and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported through the CourseOffering Entity will be that of the member district campus. An ESC should report a StaffSectionAssociation Entity when the ESC employs the instructional staff providing services in an LEA. When the fiscal agent is an ESC and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported through the CourseOffering Entity must end in 751, 998, or 999.
Each member district will report the staff responsibility data for any employees that it pays who perform shared service arrangement related services. If a staff member is an employee both of the shared services arrangement fiscal agent and of a shared services arrangement member, each organization would then report all the staff data that pertains to that individual's employment with it. TEA would receive only duplicate identification and demographic data in such a case.

NumberOfStudentsInClass (E0170) indicates the number of students served in the class.
If more than one classroom staff member is serving a group of students during the same class period, the Teacher of Record (reported with ClassroomPosition 01) is reported with all the students for NumberOfStudentsInClass. The other staff members should be reported with 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass, but may be reported with greater than 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass as necessary.
Instructional Educational Aides should be reported with 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass.
MonthlyMinutes (E1057) is the total number of minutes devoted to a particular service in a standard month. A standard month is the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
MonthlyMinutes represents a standard month of service provided during the school year and is used to calculate FTEs. Even if there is a holiday or other non-school day during the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), report this value as if the school was in operation.
MonthlyMinutes is based upon 8400 minutes a month (7 hours per day x 5 days per week x 4 weeks per month).
MonthlyMinutes is used to calculate proportional FTE for each responsibility and has no funding impact.
A class that is taught for one hour every day would report 1,200 monthly minutes (60 minutes x 5 days x 4 weeks) for that class. If school is closed for a teacher workday or student holiday, a class that is taught for one hour every day would still be reported with 1,200 monthly minutes (60 minutes x 5 days x 4 weeks) since that is the standard monthly minutes for this class.
A class taught one hour three times each week would report 720 monthly minutes (60 minutes x 3 days x 4 weeks).
A class taught for different amounts of time each week would be reported with a cumulative monthly minute total.

NumberDaysTaughtWeek1 (E1604) indicates, for a physical education teaching staff responsibility, the number of days in which physical education instruction is provided for each course section by campus during the first week of the four weeks in October that includes the last Friday in October.
The NumberDaysTaughtWeek1 is reported for physical education courses only.
If a staff person teaches a physical education class for week 1, then report NumberDaysTaughtWeek1. If said staff person does not teach a physical education class for week 1, report “0” (zero). This data element is only reported for the physical education CourseCodes listed above.
If more than one staff member is serving a group of students during a physical education class period, the person who is the "teacher of record" (ClassroomPosition 01) should be reported with NumberDaysTaughtWeek1.  No other staff members should report a value.
If there is a holiday or other non-school day during this week, report this value as if the school was in operation and instruction was offered. For example, if school is closed for a teacher’s workday, a class that is taught for one hour every day would still be reported with 5 days and 300 minutes (60 minutes x 5 days) since that is the typical weekly days and minutes for this class.

=== Entity-level rules (shared) ===
General Requirements: ## GR1
A local education agency (LEA) MUST report all professional services provided by teachers (StaffClassification 087) at an LEA through the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation entity, the StaffSectionAssociation entity or both for TEA to compute the teacher full-time equivalent (FTE) calculations for the LEA. If data for a staff member is reported through both entities, TEA will combine the data to accurately reflect the Staff FTE.
The CourseOffering, Section, and StaffSectionAssociation Entities are primarily used to report the responsibilities of a StaffClassification 087 (teacher) when the services provided by the teacher match one or more CourseCode. This includes but is not limited to teacher of record, assistant teacher, support teacher, or substitute teacher assigned to classes in the LEA master schedule, and teachers in an atypical role such as SPED, Dyslexia, GT, Intervention, pull-out teachers, etc., not assigned to a specific class but providing services with a corresponding CourseCode. The LEA must determine the appropriate CourseCode based on the services provided by the teacher to the students.
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity reflects the teachers, some substitutes, and prekindergarten instructional aides. Multiple records are required for persons who perform duties on more than one campus or assume more than one role. By definition, if no StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported, the assumption is made that the person is an auxiliary staff member or assignments are reported through the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entity.
## GR2
PEIMS Fall Submission (1):
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for the four weeks in October that include the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) for staff employed on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
If a school is closed for one or more days during the four weeks in October that include the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), then the staff responsibilities, the services performed, and the minutes associated with those services, should be reported as if the school was in operation for each of the days.
It is necessary for each LEA to report all professional services provided by persons at an LEA through the StaffSectionAssociation or the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entities in order for TEA to compute and report the staff FTE data for the LEA.
Staff responsibilities that occur before or after the normal school day for events where students do not receive credit are not reported (this includes but is not limited to sports practice, band practice, UIL clubs and practices). Staff responsibilities for courses taken for credit (including but not limited to zero hour courses) and Adult Basic Ed classes are considered part of the normal school day for StaffSectionAssociation Entity reporting purposes. Therefore, courses that are offered to students before or after school for course credit must be reported with a StaffSectionAssociation Entity.
If an instructional professional performs more than one service in the same classroom setting, then each of those services are reported on an individual StaffSectionAssociation Entity. For example, there are not enough French foreign language students (French I, French II, and French III) to make up separate classes. If these classes are combined in the same classroom at the same time, then a StaffSectionAssociation Entity will be reported for each Course (French I, French II, and French III).
Physical education, fine arts, and special education classes on elementary campuses may be reported using only one record or may be reported section by section, if desired. Because of legislative requirements for class size reporting, districts should report staff responsibility data at the lowest level possible.
Detailed schedules are not reported for ClassroomPosition 05 (PK Classroom Aide). Instead, a StaffSectionAssociation Entity is submitted showing the total monthly minutes the staff person serves in that role. The NumberOfStudentsInClass should be reported as 0 for these roles.  The actual NumberOfStudentsInClass should be reported with ClassroomPosition 01 (Teacher of Record).
PEIMS Extended Year Submission (4):
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for teachers providing instruction for the Additional Days School Year (ADSY) program. The NumberOfStudentsInClass should reflect the number of students participating in the ADSY program.
## GR3
StaffSectionAssociation Entities for local credit courses (8XXXXXXX) are not promoted in any of the TSDS Core Collections.
Class Roster Winter Submission:
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for all LEA-employed or contracted teachers of courses offered in grades EE-12 as of the last Friday in February. CourseCodes that begin with "SA," "SE," "SR," "SS," or "8" are not promoted.
Early Childhood Data System Collections
Prekindergarten (PK) Submission:
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for each ClassroomPosition that provides instruction for students in grade level PK. If more than one of any ClassroomPosition is assigned to a PK section, all StaffSectionAssociation Entities should be reported with the actual BeginDate and EndDate.
Kindergarten (KG) Submission:
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for each ClassroomPosition that provides instruction for students in grade level KG. If more than one of any ClassroomPosition is assigned to a KG section, all StaffSectionAssociation Entities should be reported with the actual BeginDate and EndDate.

Special Requirements: ## SR1
Shared Service Arrangement
The shared service arrangement fiscal agent should report the responsibility data using the StaffSectionAssociation Entity for those instructional employees who the fiscal agent pays.
When the fiscal agent is a LEA and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported through the CourseOffering Entity will be that of the member district campus. An ESC should report a StaffSectionAssociation Entity when the ESC employs the instructional staff providing services in an LEA. When the fiscal agent is an ESC and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported through the CourseOffering Entity must end in 751, 998, or 999.
Each member district will report the staff responsibility data for any employees that it pays who perform shared service arrangement related services. If a staff member is an employee both of the shared services arrangement fiscal agent and of a shared services arrangement member, each organization would then report all the staff data that pertains to that individual's employment with it. TEA would receive only duplicate identification and demographic data in such a case.

If more than one classroom staff member is serving a group of students during the same class period, the Teacher of Record (reported with ClassroomPosition 01) is reported with all the students for NumberOfStudentsInClass. The other staff members should be reported with 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass, but may be reported with greater than 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass as necessary.
Instructional Educational Aides should be reported with 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass.
MonthlyMinutes (E1057) is the total number of minutes devoted to a particular service in a standard month. A standard month is the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
MonthlyMinutes represents a standard month of service provided during the school year and is used to calculate FTEs. Even if there is a holiday or other non-school day during the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), report this value as if the school was in operation.
MonthlyMinutes is based upon 8400 minutes a month (7 hours per day x 5 days per week x 4 weeks per month).
MonthlyMinutes is used to calculate proportional FTE for each responsibility and has no funding impact.
A class that is taught for one hour every day would report 1,200 monthly minutes (60 minutes x 5 days x 4 weeks) for that class. If school is closed for a teacher workday or student holiday, a class that is taught for one hour every day would still be reported with 1,200 monthly minutes (60 minutes x 5 days x 4 weeks) since that is the standard monthly minutes for this class.
A class taught one hour three times each week would report 720 monthly minutes (60 minutes x 3 days x 4 weeks).
A class taught for different amounts of time each week would be reported with a cumulative monthly minute total.

The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for the four weeks in October that include the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October) for staff employed on the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
If a school is closed for one or more days during the four weeks in October that include the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), then the staff responsibilities, the services performed, and the minutes associated with those services, should be reported as if the school was in operation for each of the days.
It is necessary for each LEA to report all professional services provided by persons at an LEA through the StaffSectionAssociation or the StaffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociation Entities in order for TEA to compute and report the staff FTE data for the LEA.
Staff responsibilities that occur before or after the normal school day for events where students do not receive credit are not reported (this includes but is not limited to sports practice, band practice, UIL clubs and practices). Staff responsibilities for courses taken for credit (including but not limited to zero hour courses) and Adult Basic Ed classes are considered part of the normal school day for StaffSectionAssociation Entity reporting purposes. Therefore, courses that are offered to students before or after school for course credit must be reported with a StaffSectionAssociation Entity.
If an instructional professional performs more than one service in the same classroom setting, then each of those services are reported on an individual StaffSectionAssociation Entity. For example, there are not enough French foreign language students (French I, French II, and French III) to make up separate classes. If these classes are combined in the same classroom at the same time, then a StaffSectionAssociation Entity will be reported for each Course (French I, French II, and French III).
Physical education, fine arts, and special education classes on elementary campuses may be reported using only one record or may be reported section by section, if desired. Because of legislative requirements for class size reporting, districts should report staff responsibility data at the lowest level possible.
Detailed schedules are not reported for ClassroomPosition 05 (PK Classroom Aide). Instead, a StaffSectionAssociation Entity is submitted showing the total monthly minutes the staff person serves in that role. The NumberOfStudentsInClass should be reported as 0 for these roles.  The actual NumberOfStudentsInClass should be reported with ClassroomPosition 01 (Teacher of Record).
PEIMS Extended Year Submission (4):
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for teachers providing instruction for the Additional Days School Year (ADSY) program. The NumberOfStudentsInClass should reflect the number of students participating in the ADSY program.
## GR3
StaffSectionAssociation Entities for local credit courses (8XXXXXXX) are not promoted in any of the TSDS Core Collections.
Class Roster Winter Submission:
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for all LEA-employed or contracted teachers of courses offered in grades EE-12 as of the last Friday in February. CourseCodes that begin with "SA," "SE," "SR," "SS," or "8" are not promoted.
Early Childhood Data System Collections
Prekindergarten (PK) Submission:
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for each ClassroomPosition that provides instruction for students in grade level PK. If more than one of any ClassroomPosition is assigned to a PK section, all StaffSectionAssociation Entities should be reported with the actual BeginDate and EndDate.
Kindergarten (KG) Submission:
The StaffSectionAssociation Entity is reported for each ClassroomPosition that provides instruction for students in grade level KG. If more than one of any ClassroomPosition is assigned to a KG section, all StaffSectionAssociation Entities should be reported with the actual BeginDate and EndDate.

Special Requirements: ## SR1
Shared Service Arrangement
The shared service arrangement fiscal agent should report the responsibility data using the StaffSectionAssociation Entity for those instructional employees who the fiscal agent pays.
When the fiscal agent is a LEA and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported through the CourseOffering Entity will be that of the member district campus. An ESC should report a StaffSectionAssociation Entity when the ESC employs the instructional staff providing services in an LEA. When the fiscal agent is an ESC and services are provided on a member district campus, the School reported through the CourseOffering Entity must end in 751, 998, or 999.
Each member district will report the staff responsibility data for any employees that it pays who perform shared service arrangement related services. If a staff member is an employee both of the shared services arrangement fiscal agent and of a shared services arrangement member, each organization would then report all the staff data that pertains to that individual's employment with it. TEA would receive only duplicate identification and demographic data in such a case.

If more than one classroom staff member is serving a group of students during the same class period, the Teacher of Record (reported with ClassroomPosition 01) is reported with all the students for NumberOfStudentsInClass. The other staff members should be reported with 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass, but may be reported with greater than 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass as necessary.
Instructional Educational Aides should be reported with 0 for NumberOfStudentsInClass.
MonthlyMinutes (E1057) is the total number of minutes devoted to a particular service in a standard month. A standard month is the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October).
MonthlyMinutes represents a standard month of service provided during the school year and is used to calculate FTEs. Even if there is a holiday or other non-school day during the four weeks in October, including the PEIMS Fall snapshot date (last Friday in October), report this value as if the school was in operation.
MonthlyMinutes is based upon 8400 minutes a month (7 hours per day x 5 days per week x 4 weeks per month).
MonthlyMinutes is used to calculate proportional FTE for each responsibility and has no funding impact.
A class that is taught for one hour every day would report 1,200 monthly minutes (60 minutes x 5 days x 4 weeks) for that class. If school is closed for a teacher workday or student holiday, a class that is taught for one hour every day would still be reported with 1,200 monthly minutes (60 minutes x 5 days x 4 weeks) since that is the standard monthly minutes for this class.
A class taught one hour three times each week would report 720 monthly minutes (60 minutes x 3 days x 4 weeks).
A class taught for different amounts of time each week would be reported with a cumulative monthly minute total.
